sources: https://www.stlucieco.gov/departments-and-services/parks-recreation-department/savannas-recreation-area (read in a browser; plain fetch refused)

values.note: St. Lucie County, plus tax: full-hookup sites $22.32 a night May 1 - October 31, $25.89 November 1 - April 30 (monthly $601.79 / $708.93); tent sites $19.64. Rent is due weekly in advance, paid in person at the Trading Post.

fees.source: https://www.stlucieco.gov/departments-and-services/parks-recreation-department/savannas-recreation-area (Campsite Rates tables, 'Full Site Nightly $22.32/night' May 1 - October 31, '$25.89/night' November 1 - April 30), read 2026-10-21

hookups.source: https://www.stlucieco.gov/departments-and-services/parks-recreation-department/savannas-recreation-area ('Full RV Hookup Sites: Water, sewer, and electric connections available'), read 2026-10-21

facilities.source: https://www.stlucieco.gov/departments-and-services/parks-recreation-department/savannas-recreation-area (Camping Amenities: 'Hot Showers', 'Public Restrooms', 'Laundry Room', 'WiFi for Guests'), read 2026-10-21

season.source: https://www.stlucieco.gov/departments-and-services/parks-recreation-department/savannas-recreation-area ('The Savannas is open year-round and offers opportunities for camping'; campsite rates published for May-October and November-April), read 2026-10-21

values.note: Camping registration by phone at 772-464-7855 or in person at the Trading Post (campground office). Tent sites are first-come, first-served. RV campers may stay up to 155 days in a 12-month period.

booking.source: https://www.stlucieco.gov/departments-and-services/parks-recreation-department/savannas-recreation-area ('Camping registration and pavilion reservations can be made in person at the Trading Post or by calling 772-464-7855'; tent sites 'Designated areas available first-come, first-served') + https://www.stlucieco.gov/departments-and-services/parks-recreation-department/savannas-recreation-area-camping-rules-and-regulations ('RV campers may stay up to 155 days within a 12-month period'), read 2026-10-21

note: St. Lucie County Parks campground in the 550-acre Savannas Preserve, Fort Pierce. Reservations up to a year out, not site-specific. --Claude
summary: Confirmed on St. Lucie County's own pages: $22.32 (May-Oct) / $25.89 (Nov-Apr) full-hookup nightly plus tax, water/sewer/electric, hot showers, laundry, Wi-Fi, booked by phone or at the Trading Post; added year-round season and the 155-days-a-year RV limit. Not stated: amperage, site count, rig length, booking window. Note trimmed of field facts and the rating line.
